profile.org_note: Kolter Homes (founded as Kolter Signature Homes LLC; Kolter Homes office at 4807 PGA Boulevard, Palm Beach Gardens) is the homebuilding affiliate of The Kolter Group LLC, a private real estate firm led by CEO Bobby Julien from 105 NE 1st Street, Delray Beach. The group runs five divisions plus a services arm: Kolter Urban (condominiums; President Bob Vail), Kolter Homes (President Robert Smithwick), Kolter Multifamily (President Jeff Quinlivan), Kolter Hospitality (President Scott Webb), Kolter Land (President Jim Harvey; Tampa) and Kolter Financial Services (K Title, CTC Mortgage; President Guido Virgili). Kolter Homes itself is organised as a president, two EVPs (Finance, Operations) and three division presidents (Southeast Florida, Mid-Southeast US, Carolinas). Land and capital decisions sit largely outside the builder: land sourcing and lot development run through Kolter Land, which since November 2024 operates as Brookfield Kolter Land Partners with Brookfield Residential as part owner, and capital-provider relationships, treasury and project debt sit at group level (COO Howard Erbstein, CFO Bill Johnson, Director - Capital Markets Malcolm Joy). Inside Kolter Homes, EVP Finance Chris Schmitz is on the acquisition team and EVP Operations Derek Fenech oversees land development.
profile.email_pattern: flast@kolterhomes.com (Kolter Homes); flast@kolter.com (Kolter Group, Kolter Land, Kolter Financial Services)
profile.summary: Private Southeast builder of amenity-heavy master-planned and 55+ communities (Cresswind brand) in Florida, Georgia, the Carolinas and, newly, coastal Alabama. It is one arm of The Kolter Group, which describes more than $30 billion of expected project value across homes, condos, multifamily, hotels and land. A land banker should note that its sister company Kolter Land is itself a finished-lot supplier to other builders and took Brookfield Residential in as an owner in November 2024, and that capital relationships are run by the group's COO and CFO rather than by the builder.
